question: How do I legally change my name?

nuggets.text: A District resident applies to the Superior Court giving the reasons and the new name.
nuggets.quote: Whoever, being a resident of the District and desiring a change of name, may file an application in the Superior Court setting forth the reasons therefor and also the name desired to be assumed.

nuggets.text: On a satisfactory showing the court changes the name.
nuggets.quote: (a) Upon a showing that the court deems satisfactory, the court may change the name of the applicant according to the prayer of the application.

nuggets.text: The same court declares a change of gender.
nuggets.quote: (b) (1) Any District resident may seek a declaration by the Superior Court reflecting a change of gender.

nuggets.text: The application sets out the reasons and the name desired.
